player_prompt.intro:
Yin ater Tower of Hanoi nhom {num_disks} guop.
Yin aci guop guop kada A guop C.
Guop ater guop, yen e type wär tower ku wär tower (e.g., '[A C]').
Nhial, aci yen guop wec ku guop, ku guop de apuruk aci yen guop ku guop de luel.
Kada kadiat, yen e submit wec.
